storage: Closed container in a dry place.

reactions.note: Dissolves to give a blue solution of hydrated copper ions.
Heating drives off the water and the crystals turn white.
Gives a pale blue precipitate with sodium hydroxide.

educational_notes: The blue colour comes from water molecules bound to the copper(II) ion.
